Contact.title: Let's talk.
Contact.intro: Hiring a full-stack developer with AI expertise? Full-time role, contract or freelance engagement — let's talk about what I can bring to your team.

About.paragraph1: Full-stack AI developer. After 21 years in the French Army, I retrained in 2024 — first in web development, then in AI engineering. Today I combine dual expertise: full-stack development and AI-driven automation.
About.paragraph2: In 2025 I founded Gecko Mind: B2B acquisition systems powered by AI agents, with a multi-agent architecture across the full pipeline — LinkedIn prospecting, qualification, content creation. Designed, built and operated end to end.
About.paragraph3: My stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind on the front end; Node.js, Python, FastAPI, LangChain, SQL and Supabase on the back end; Docker, Vercel, Render and GCP for deployment. All AI-assisted, with Claude Code and Cursor daily.
